title: Most news feeds are broken because they treat everyone like the same person.
body:
When you open a typical news app, you are fed a mix of sensational headlines, irrelevant local stories, and topics you stopped caring about months ago. It is designed to grab attention for a few seconds rather than inform you about the things that actually matter to your life or your work.

True personalization is not about showing you more of what you already click on. It is about understanding the context behind your interests. If you are tracking a specific industry, you do not need the same broad headlines as everyone else. You need the deep dives, the analysis, and the updates that change your perspective on that topic.

We built Headlinne to solve this noise problem. By using AI to filter out the fluff and focus on what is genuinely relevant to you, we are trying to make the daily news cycle feel like a resource instead of a chore. It is about giving you back your time while keeping you sharper.
cta: You can see how we are rethinking the feed at HEADLINNE.com.
